question: Nabakalebar is a ritual in which the wooden figures of Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra, Subhadra and Sudarshan are periodically renewed. Where is the Nabakalebar Rath Yatra held?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Puri__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ​Puri is the city in Odisha where** Nabakalebar Rath Yatra** is held.
 
• Nabakalebar is a ritual in which the wooden figures of **Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra, Subhadra, and Sudarshan** are periodically renewed.
 
• Nabakalebara is an important festival in the Hindu Odia Calendar, observed in the **Jagannath Temple, Puri**. 
 
• It was first organized in** 1575 A.D. by Yaduvansh Bhoi**** King Ramchandra Deva**.
 
• It marks the symbolic demise and rebirth of **Jagannath at Puri**. 
 
• The event involves the installation of new images in the Jagannath temple and the burial of the old ones on the temple premises at** Koili Baikuntha**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The capital of Odisha is** Bhubaneshwar**.
 
• The chief minister of Odisha is **Naveen Patnaik**.
 
• The Minister of culture is chaired by **G. Kishan Reddy**.
